runOrder: Coordinate with the LED tech to put the raffle page on the LED wall

rules: Everyone who wants to play stands up.
Hands on head = A. Hands on hips = B.
Wrong answer: sit down. Last one standing wins.
Ask everyone to raise both hands before each question, then choose, so nobody copies their tablemates.
If the last few all get one wrong, bring them back and use a tiebreaker (closest number wins).

questions.q: What course did we both take in college?
How did we really get close?
questions.b: Blockmates who sat beside each other

questions.q: The engineering board exam: did we take it together or separately?
How long have we been together?
Who did more of the thesis work?
Who fell asleep first during late lab nights?
Who cried first during the proposal?
Who's more likely to be running late?
Who has the longer skincare routine?
Who will cry first during the vows today?

tiebreakers.q: How many days have we been together as of today?
In what month and year did we become official?
How many guests are at the reception tonight?

rules: Each table plays as one team.
The band or tech plays the first few seconds of a song.
The first table to stand and shout the title (and artist, for a bonus) gets the point.
Wrong guess: that table sits out the rest of that song.
The table with the most points at the end wins.
